archiveTitle: Morning Brief | Gravhounds Reveals Co-op Survival Gameplay

entries.headline: Gravhounds Revealed: Four-Player Co-op Base Building on Alien World, Game Preview on November 2
entries.summary: Octopus Panic announced the co-op survival game Gravhounds, planned to enter Game Preview on November 2 for Xbox Series and Xbox PC, launching day one on Game Pass. Players take on the role of bio-engineered dogs, gathering resources, laying pipelines and defenses on an alien planet, with up to four players cooperating to evacuate.
entries.verification: Opened the first-party Xbox Wire article; release stage, date, platforms, Game Pass, and four-player co-op details all come from the developer's statement.

mediaAlts.alt: Gravhounds: Image accompanying the announcement of four-player co-op base building on an alien world, entering Game Preview on November 2.

entries.headline: Scott Pilgrim EX 'Back in the Band' DLC Launches, Adds Three Playable Characters
entries.summary: The 'Back in the Band' DLC for Scott Pilgrim EX is now available on PlayStation platforms, adding three playable characters: Stephen Stills, Kim Pine, and Knives Chau. Tribute Games also detailed the design process for the character select screen, idle animations, and combat performance.

entries.headline: Alien Deathstorm Shows New Trailer, Highlighting Storm Environments and Engineer Combat Abilities
entries.summary: Rebellion released a new trailer for the sci-fi action-horror shooter Alien Deathstorm. Players take on the role of an engineer sent on a rescue mission to a lost colony; the trailer focuses on planetary-scale storms, first-person combat, and engineering equipment.

entries.headline: Xbox Free Play Days This Weekend Includes Multiple Games; Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Test Begins Early August 29
entries.summary: This week's Xbox Free Play Days includes Naruto to Boruto: Shinobi Striker, ARK: Survival Ascended, Control Ultimate Edition, and Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves, among others. The Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 open test begins at 01:00 Beijing time on August 29. Membership requirements vary by title.

entries.headline: Surreal Immersive Sim Militsioner Coming to Xbox and PC in 2027, Day One on Game Pass
entries.summary: Militsioner is confirmed to launch on Xbox Series and Xbox PC in 2027, supporting Xbox Play Anywhere and launching day one on Game Pass. Players must escape a town under the constant surveillance of a giant police officer, with outcomes shaped by deception, negotiation, or direct flight.

entries.headline: Tidying Narrative Game Whisper of the House Launches on PS5
entries.summary: The tidying and light mystery game Whisper of the House is now available on PS5. Players work as a housekeeper in Whisper Town, taking on commissions such as moving, cleaning rooms, arranging shops, and finding lost items, piecing together residents' stories from indoor objects and placement details.

entries.headline: Four-Player Co-op Physics Building Game What Goes Up Announced, Coming to Consoles and PC This Year
entries.summary: Team17 announced What Goes Up, developed by Bossa Games. Players salvage junk on a dangerous planet and, under time-limited objectives, stack objects like bathtubs and stalls into towers or bridges. The game supports solo and up to four-player online co-op, planned for release later this year on PS5, Xbox Series, and PC, and will be included in PC and Xbox Game Pass.
entries.verification: Opened independent reports from AUTOMATON and Gematsu; developer, publisher, platforms, co-op player count, this-year window, and Game Pass details align across both.

entries.headline: Turn-Based Tactical Roguelite Wishseeker Announced for PC
entries.summary: Wishseeker, a turn-based tactical roguelite, has been announced for PC. Players lead a four-person party through dungeons that change each run, engaging in fast combat on a grid battlefield that emphasizes positioning and skill combinations. A release date has not yet been announced.

entries.headline: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Remake Enlists HD Reworked Project Author
entries.summary: HalkHogan, author of The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt HD Reworked Project, has confirmed involvement in the remake's development. The mod has long overhauled the original's models and textures and was integrated into the 2022 next-gen update. This collaboration continues CD PROJEKT RED's pattern of incorporating community graphical improvements.
entries.verification: Opened the AUTOMATON report; the statement about involvement, the mod's use, and its relation to the 2022 update all come from the text.

entries.headline: ELDEN RING Updated to Ver.1.17, Adjusting Greatshields, Guarding, and Flow Weapons
entries.summary: FromSoftware released Ver.1.17 for ELDEN RING, preparing for the 'Tarnished Pack' launching on August 28 and adjusting various weapon types and combat mechanics. The report highlights include weight reduction and buffs for multi-faced greatshields, adjustments to guarding and parrying, and damage increases for flow weapons.

entries.headline: Newzoo Expects Grand Theft Auto VI to Drive 17.5% Growth in 2026 Console Premium Game Spending
entries.summary: AUTOMATON cites Newzoo's '2026 Global Games Market Report' stating that the global games market is expected to grow 6.1% year-over-year to $213.9 billion in 2026, with console premium game spending projected to grow 17.5%, attributed primarily to Grand Theft Auto VI. These figures are market forecasts, not actual sales results.
entries.verification: Opened the AUTOMATON report; market size, growth rates, and driving factors are relayed as reported, with the forecast nature explicitly retained.
